expectations.text: Exactly four numbered steps in original operational order.
expectations.evidence: The output has exactly four numbered lines: status, snapshot, apply, then health check and conditional rollback.

expectations.text: Every source code span is preserved exactly, including both /healthz occurrences and rollback command.
expectations.evidence: The six code spans are exactly: `deployctl status --env staging`; `deployctl snapshot --label pre-release`; `deployctl apply release.yaml --env staging`; `/healthz`; `/healthz`; `deployctl rollback --label pre-release`. Both endpoint occurrences survive.

expectations.text: HTTP 200 check and rollback after 60 seconds on non-200 remain required, not optional or unconditional.
expectations.evidence: “Check `/healthz` for HTTP 200. If `/healthz` is not HTTP 200 after 60 seconds, run `deployctl rollback --label pre-release`.” The check and conditional rollback remain imperative.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
